evidence_items.content_summary: Launches train.py with Multi30k data, label smoothing, projection weight sharing, batch size 256, warmup 4000, 200 epochs, seed 1, tensorboard, and shell-provided lr/scale overrides.
Parses training arguments, sets reproducibility options, loads data, instantiates Transformer, wraps Adam with ScheduledOptim, and calls train().
Runs one training epoch by preparing source/target tensors, forwarding through the model, computing label-smoothed performance, backpropagating, and updating the scheduled optimizer.
Downloads raw corpora, merges train/validation/test files, learns BPE codes, encodes text, filters examples by max length, builds vocabulary, and serializes processed data.
Defines an encoder layer composed of self-attention followed by a position-wise feed-forward sublayer.
Defines a decoder layer composed of decoder self-attention, encoder-decoder attention, and position-wise feed-forward sublayers.
Projects queries, keys, and values into multiple heads, applies scaled dot-product attention, concatenates heads, then applies residual connection and layer normalization.
Defines the position-wise feed-forward sublayer with two linear projections, ReLU, dropout, residual connection, and layer normalization.
Wraps an optimizer and updates the learning rate each step using the Transformer warmup schedule based on d_model, step count, warmup steps, and lr multiplier.
Comment suggests better shell settings for lr_mul and scale_emb_or_prj; this is a soft hint only.
